hermetic_exceptions.reason: The affected-set gate is an orchestrator that invokes the owned Buck2 build/test boundary to compute the admission cone; the predicate result is derived from Buck2 reports, not ad-hoc shell policy. Count raised 5->6 for the ADR-0554 round-6 FULL-tier test-health ratchet, which spawns `buck2 test //...` to capture per-target verdicts (buck2's --build-report cannot express runtime test pass/fail).
hermetic_exceptions.cutover_note: Replace the subprocess edge with the typed cloud-ci runner/reconciler API when that API owns Buck2 execution; keep the exception visible until then.

hermetic_exceptions.reason: The affected-set gate uses wall-clock instants only to emit live operator phase elapsed-seconds telemetry while Buck2 or the wrapped child command runs; pass/fail verdicts still come from child exit status and Buck2 reports.
hermetic_exceptions.cutover_note: Replace Instant-based adapter heartbeat timing with typed cloud-ci runner phase events when the runner/reconciler API owns long-step progress telemetry.

hermetic_exceptions.reason: The firewall app uses wall time only to stamp human-reviewed signoff metadata; the gate verdict is computed from the candidate and frozen baseline data, not from the clock.
hermetic_exceptions.cutover_note: Move signoff metadata stamping behind the typed audit packet producer so verifier code stays clock-free; verdict code must remain independent of this exception.

hermetic_exceptions.reason: Freshness is the generated-face regeneration orchestrator: it invokes owned Buck2-built emitters/producers and compares regenerated bytes to the candidate tree. Current shell-outs are transitional and explicitly baselined instead of silently allowed.
hermetic_exceptions.cutover_note: Drive regeneration and SCM facts through the typed Buck2/reconciler API plus scm-facts emitter contract, then delete Command::new from freshness production code. Count raised 17->23 for the de-commit regen-from-merge-base-tracked-tree path (ADR-0616): freshness now spawns the emitter/producer/codemod and git plumbing that regenerate the seven de-committed faces from the merge-base tree, so the transitional subprocess edges are explicitly baselined until the typed reconciler owns regeneration.

hermetic_exceptions.reason: Freshness SystemTime::now is restricted to unique temporary file names for scm-facts, volatile facts, masterplan projection, and product graph scratch files; it does not feed the regenerated bytes comparison or pass/fail verdict.
hermetic_exceptions.cutover_note: Replace temp-name wall-clock entropy with the typed scratch allocator when the reconciler API lands; until then, keep every SystemTime::now occurrence in temporary_* helpers only. Count raised 4->8 for the de-commit regen-from-merge-base-tracked-tree path (ADR-0616): each de-committed face regenerated from the merge-base tree needs a unique scratch temp name, so the additional wall-clock entropy is confined to temporary-name helpers and never feeds the regenerated-bytes comparison or verdict.

hermetic_exceptions.reason: Kernel-purity invokes cargo metadata only after its fixer edits manifests so corrupt rewrites roll back; the blocking gate predicate remains policy/data driven and Buck2-tested.
hermetic_exceptions.cutover_note: Move semantic manifest validation behind the owned workspace-members/manifest parser so the fixer rollback path no longer shells to cargo.

policy_literal_exceptions.reason: The freshness rust-toolchain drift helper names the cloud-kernel nested workspace as a current repo exception while checking workspace toolchain drift; this is current-shape inventory, not readiness semantics.
policy_literal_exceptions.cutover_note: Move nested-workspace skip paths into the freshness policy data when the typed toolchain drift contract is split from the orchestrator.

no_autofix_reason.affected-target-set: The admission cone is computed from changed targets and Buck2 reports; remediation depends on the source change and cannot be rewritten safely by the gate.
no_autofix_reason.endpoint-authorization-coverage: Unauthenticated control-plane findings require product authorization design changes; the baseline writer is review-gated and not a safe automatic fix.
no_autofix_reason.automation-coverage: Automation-ratchet findings require choosing the durable automation owner and cannot be mechanically rewritten from observation rows.
no_autofix_reason.crate-layer-suffix: Crate naming and layer placement are design decisions; an automatic rename would break imports, manifests, and ownership without review.
no_autofix_reason.build-cache-policy: Cache topology violations require runner/cache policy decisions, so the gate reports exact wiring gaps instead of mutating CI configuration.
no_autofix_reason.resource-contract-conformance: Cloud-resource contract findings require source specification changes or reviewed claim-boundary decisions; the gate cannot safely rewrite product readiness or actuation semantics.
no_autofix_reason.contract-slice-conformance: Contract-slice findings (missing required field, forbidden interpreter/CLI marker in a spec, enum/array/object-member violation, or a bad migration declaration) are repaired by the slice author editing the committed spec JSON or the contract-slice-policy DATA; there is no safe mechanical rewrite of a contract's meaning.
no_autofix_reason.canonical-json: This gate already ships an explicit --fix path; the policy reason remains as documentation for adopters that disable rewriting.
no_autofix_reason.module-membership: Capability membership gaps require source-of-truth registry ownership decisions, not a blind generated mapping.
no_autofix_reason.crate-name-prefix: Prefix violations are migration-sensitive naming decisions; remediation is a reviewed rename or neutral-profile policy change.
no_autofix_reason.service-catalog-parity: Catalog liveness findings require either restoring a crate or explicitly marking the catalog row non-live; the gate cannot infer intent.
no_autofix_reason.license-policy: License policy findings require choosing an allowed license, removing the dependency, or recording reviewed license approval; the gate cannot synthesize that decision.
no_autofix_reason.topology-manifest-contract: Cell topology manifest contract findings require source-of-truth spec, fixture, root-hub, or ADR-scope decisions; the gate must not synthesize topology or residency evidence.
no_autofix_reason.policy-deploy-parity: Cedar deployment parity findings require authored policy changes or deployed ConfigMap fixes, both security-sensitive human decisions.
no_autofix_reason.cross-artifact-agreement: Cross-artifact contradictions must be resolved at the authoritative artifact, never guessed by an automatic rewrite.
no_autofix_reason.crypto-backend-policy: Crypto backend activation changes are security-sensitive dependency choices and cannot be rewritten safely by the gate.
no_autofix_reason.dependency-automation: Dependency automation policy violations require ownership of the dependency update surface, not automatic config synthesis.
no_autofix_reason.caller-supplied-authorization: Caller-supplied authorization trust findings require server-side PDP integration, not a mechanical baseline expansion.
no_autofix_reason.embedded-asset-hermeticity: Embedded asset findings require BUCK src mapping or source layout changes, which are repo-shape decisions.
no_autofix_reason.hook-wiring: Enforcement liveness failures require wiring real hook/settings/controller surfaces; the gate cannot safely invent enforcement.
no_autofix_reason.baseline-ratchet: Firewall ratchet failures require reducing the violating keys or reviewed signoff; automatic mutation would launder debt.
no_autofix_reason.generated-artifact-freshness: Freshness failures require regenerating generated faces from authoritative sources or fixing the source drift; automatic mutation is separated into explicit materializer binaries.
no_autofix_reason.action-item-accounting: Friction accounting findings require valid ledger semantics and owner routing; the gate cannot invent remediation ownership.
no_autofix_reason.gate-self-conformance: Gate self-conformance findings require changing gate code, Buck2 wiring, workflow registration, or policy exceptions; automatic rewrites would hide the review decision.
no_autofix_reason.generated-artifact-policy: Generated artifact policy findings require classifying artifact authority and generated-path ownership, not blind path edits.
no_autofix_reason.parity-claim-evidence: Hyperscaler taxonomy gaps are product-readiness classification decisions and must be resolved in the taxonomy source.
no_autofix_reason.core-dependency-isolation: Kernel-purity ships a fixer for dependency declarations, but topology and semantic validation failures still require reviewed source changes.
no_autofix_reason.package-manifest-hygiene: Manifest hygiene findings require package metadata and ownership decisions; the gate reports exact missing fields for reviewed repair.
no_autofix_reason.feature-maturity-policy: Planned-maturity findings require authored PRD traceability, rich capability records, or explicit retired-plan provenance/live-ref decisions; the gate must not invent readiness evidence.
no_autofix_reason.graphql-usage-policy: GraphQL reintroduction requires an explicit reversing ADR or removal; the gate cannot author that decision automatically.
no_autofix_reason.operator-secret-rbac: Operator secret bootstrap findings are security/RBAC design changes and must be repaired explicitly.
no_autofix_reason.port-placement: Port-placement findings require moving traits across clean-architecture boundaries, not a safe local text rewrite.
no_autofix_reason.repo-root-hygiene: Root workspace hygiene findings require deciding whether to move, allowlist, or delete a tracked root artifact.
no_autofix_reason.runner-disk-reclaim: Runner disk reclaim findings require CI runner policy and reclaim-plan changes, not a gate-authored mutation.
no_autofix_reason.slo-coverage: SLO coverage findings require authoring real service objectives and ownership, which the gate cannot synthesize.
no_autofix_reason.stale-artifact-detection: Staleness findings require source artifact refresh, owner escalation, or lifecycle closure; automatic deletion would be unsafe.
no_autofix_reason.dependency-graph-acyclicity: Dependency DAG cycles require architectural refactoring across crates, not a mechanical edit.
no_autofix_reason.supply-chain-audit: Supply-chain findings require dependency upgrades, vendor review, or explicit security decisions.
no_autofix_reason.build-target-parity: Target parity findings require build/test target wiring decisions and cannot be inferred safely from one file.
no_autofix_reason.layer-dependency-acyclicity: Tier dependency findings require topology changes across capability boundaries, not automatic rewrites.
no_autofix_reason.service-tier-metadata: Tier field coverage findings require choosing authoritative service tier metadata.
no_autofix_reason.artifact-accountability: Total-accounting findings require ownership, reachability, or TTL source changes; the gate should never invent accounting rows.
no_autofix_reason.workspace-member-coverage: Workspace glob coverage findings require workspace membership or exclusion policy changes, not blind manifest edits.
